The sample is a Phase 3 clinical trial for patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. The trial is testing the drug rimonabant (sr141716). The sample is a clinical trial in Phase 3 for patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. The trial involves the use of the drugs rosiglitazone, sulfonylurea, and metformin. The sample is for a Phase 3 clinical trial focusing on patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM). The exclusion criteria specify conditions such as a history of diabetic ketoacidosis, type 1 diabetes mellitus, and recent severe hypoglycemic episodes. The sample is a Phase 3 trial focusing on Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. The trial involves the drugs ipragliflozin and nateglinide. The sample provided is for a Phase 3 clinical trial focusing on migraine treatment using the drug topiramate. The sample provided is for a Phase 3 clinical trial involving patients with diabetes, specifically Type 2 diabetes. The sample data represents a clinical trial in Phase 3 for patients with Diabetes. The trial involves the drugs nutropinaq (gh) and increlex (igf-i) as well as nutropinaq.
